types.name: TaskId
types.description: Integer surrogate key for a task row, generated by PostgreSQL SERIAL.

types.name: TaskStatus
types.description: Closed set of allowed task lifecycle states; enforced by backend validation and database CHECK-equivalent logic.

types.name: Timestamp
types.description: ISO 8601 datetime string with timezone (e.g. '2025-01-15T12:00:00+00:00'). Stored as TIMESTAMPTZ in DB, serialized as string over the wire.

types.name: Task

validators.error_message: Title must be between 1 and 255 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Free-text task description. Null when not provided.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current lifecycle state of the task.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Immutable creation timestamp set by the database on INSERT.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Last-modification timestamp set by the backend on every UPDATE.

types.description: Complete task resource representation returned by all GET/POST/PUT endpoints; mirrors the database row with timestamps serialized as ISO strings.

types.name: OptionalString
types.description: A string value that may be null. Used for nullable text fields like task description.

types.name: TaskList
types.description: Ordered array of Task objects returned by GET /tasks (ordered by created_at DESC).

types.name: TaskCreateRequest

fields.name: title
fields.description: Task title. Must be non-empty, max 255 characters.

validators.error_message: Title must be between 1 and 255 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional task description. Null if omitted or empty string submitted.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Initial task status. Defaults to 'pending' if not provided.

types.description: Request body for POST /tasks — creates a new task.

types.name: TaskUpdateRequest

fields.name: title
fields.description: New title. If provided, must be non-empty, max 255 characters.

validators.error_message: Title must be between 1 and 255 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.description: New description. Explicit null clears the field.

fields.name: status
fields.description: New status. Must be a valid TaskStatus variant.

types.description: Request body for PUT /tasks/{id} — partial update (PATCH semantics). Only provided fields are modified; created_at is never affected.

types.name: HealthResponse
types.description: Response body for GET /health indicating service liveness.

types.name: ErrorResponse
types.description: Standard error envelope returned on 404 (and other error codes) with a human-readable detail message.

types.name: DeleteConfirmation

fields.name: id
fields.description: The id of the task that was deleted.

types.description: Response body for DELETE /tasks/{id} on successful hard-delete (HTTP 200).
